description: Uploads a large local file (> 20 MiB up to 5 GB) and immediately attaches it as a block to a Notion page or parent block.

blockId.description: The Notion page ID or parent block ID where the file should be appended.

blockType.description: Optional block type. If omitted, inferred from MIME type.

caption.description: Optional text caption to display beneath the file block in Notion.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type. If omitted, inferred from file extension.

name: upload_and_attach_to_notion
